registration.name: TUKABEL · Margita · Ostrý chraplavý skřehot
registration.description: Native Slovak, slovenčina, unmistakably Slovak vowels and crisp consonants. Female, about fifty. A ferocious, commanding woman: low-mid chest voice with a metallic saw-toothed buzz, extremely coarse raspy edges and pinched nasal bite. Sharp barking starts, brutally clipped endings and sudden theatrical rises of annoyance. The unmistakable delivery of a household commander shouting over an argument, hilarious and impatient, NEVER smooth or soothing. Strong middle register, no breathy softness. Standard colloquial Slovak, aggressive staccato emphasis. Extreme animated black-comedy character acting, not a civil everyday voice, not an announcer or an audiobook narrator. Preserve understandable words at a moderate pace. Dry close recording, no background, music, echo, sound effects or digital pitch-shifter artifacts.
